html:
Paul Kagame is the Rwandan commander who led the Rwandan Patriotic Front to victory in 1994 and has ruled Rwanda since, as vice president and then from 2000 as president.

His family fled to Uganda after the revolution when he was a small child. He served in Museveni's rebel army and Ugandan intelligence, then took command of the RPF in the civil war.

After the genocide he rebuilt the state, banned ethnic labels and drove fast growth, cleaner cities and better health care. His armies invaded Zaire twice, in the First and Second Congo Wars. Critics point to opposition leaders jailed or killed abroad and elections won with nearly all the votes, and to the presidential term limits changed by referendum in 2015.
sum: Paul Kagame is the Rwandan commander who led the Rwandan Patriotic Front to victory in 1994 and has ruled Rwanda since, as vice president and then from 2000 as president.
